name: project_open
description: Open a project by name (one of the four sample projects or one of the user's own) and show its Project window: 'open the drone project', 'let's work on the rocket', 'open my classifier'. Takes the name as said: an alias like drone, quad, quadcopter, truck, car, rocket, classifier or model, or a project's title. The answer has the project's loop of steps (which are available, and why not) and next_step with a say line: offer that step to the user in your own words. A sample (RC truck, Quadcopter, Rocket, Image classifier) is a worked example with some history already, to look around: the answer says sample true and what it shows; the user can try any step there, and to keep their work offer Make my own with project_copy.

name.description: The project as the user said it ('drone', 'the RC truck', 'my rover'), or an id like proj_quadcopter.

name: project_step
description: Do one step of the open project's loop, the same as tapping it in the Project window: RC truck course, drive, train, autopilot, code; Quadcopter design, course, fly, train, autopilot; Rocket design, simulate, launch; Image classifier and other ML projects data, train, results, publish. Without step it does the next step. Every project also has send, which only drafts its latest result to the project's channel for the user to Send or Cancel. Publish only reads back what would go on GitHub; the user confirms to Albie before anything is pushed. A step that isn't available answers why, and which stage to go to first. For moving between stages ('go back to the design', 'what's next?') prefer project_stage.

step.description: The step to do. Default: the next step.

name: project_stage
description: Move between the stages of the open project, the same as tapping a stage on its project bar: 'go to the design stage', 'back to flying', 'let's train it', 'next stage'. The stage's tool opens and the one before is put away; a stage whose earlier stages aren't done answers why and which stage to go to first (offer that). Without stage it changes nothing and answers where the project is: every stage's status (done, ready, stale: made on an older design, locked) and result, current_stage, next_stage and a say line; use it for 'what's next?' and 'where am I?'.

stage.description: The stage as said (design, course, drive, fly, train, autopilot, code, simulate, launch, data, results, publish, cad) or next. Omit to only ask what's next.

name: project_copy
description: Make my own (the old name is kept): 'make my own truck', 'copy the rocket', 'I want my own drone'. Nothing is copied: it opens Build something with the sample's kind already picked and answers with the next question and its choices; ask it, and the user's answers go to os_answer. Start on the plan card makes the user's own project ('My RC truck') with its own plan and the sample's steps; the sample stays as it is. Only from the four samples; for anything else open Build something. Without name it uses the open sample.

name.description: The sample as the user said it ('the truck', 'quadcopter'), or an id like proj_rocket. Default: the open sample.
